born.why: The code prioritizes safety by ignoring known poisonous fruits, seeks unknown fruits for exploration when healthy to build a knowledge base, and consumes safe fruits immediately to satisfy hunger, while avoiding unnecessary carrying of neutral items.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding known poisons, eating known safe food immediately, and taking calculated risks with unknowns only when starvation is critical or when having a hunger buffer to afford the cost of tasting for information gain.

The code prioritizes survival by eating known safe fruits immediately, avoiding known poisonous ones, and cautiously tasting unknown fruits only when health permits to gather data, ensuring long-term viability.

This code improves survival by prioritizing immediate consumption of known-safe fruits, using trait-based analogy for unknowns to minimize blind risks, and refusing to taste highly correlated poisonous traits unless starving, thus balancing information gathering with safety.

This code prioritizes survival by eating any food when starvation is imminent (>90 hunger), avoids known poisonous fruits reliably using a diary lookup, and intelligently switches carried items only if the new fruit is known to be superior or the current one is unsafe/unknown, while tasting unknowns only when hunger levels allow for safe exploration.

This code prioritizes survival by eating unknowns only when critical or highly hungry, otherwise tasting to safely expand the database of safe species, while strictly avoiding known poisons and handling carrying constraints logically.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when felt hunger is critical, learns new fruits by tasting only when safe, avoids known poisons, and strategically decides to carry or eat based on current hunger levels and existing knowledge to maximize long-term energy intake.
